sentences.text: Welcome to the Slow English podcast.
My name is Emili.
Today, we will talk about a city in Azerbaijan.
This city is called Ganga.
Ganga is an old, calm, and beautiful city.
It has culture, history, and friendly people.
Part two, where is Ganga?
Ganga is in the west of Azerbaijan.
It is the second largest city in the country.
It is close to green mountains and lakes.
The nature around Ganga is peaceful and relaxing.
Part three, a very old city.
Ganga is more than 1,000 years old.
It has a long history.
Many empires lived here.
This makes Ganga an important cultural city in the region.
Part four, Nizami Ganjavi.
Ganga is the hometown of Nizami Ganjavi.
He was a very famous poet.
People in Azerbaijan love him.
There is a big mausoleum for Nizami in Ganga.
Many tourists visit this place every year.
Part five, beautiful architecture.
Many buildings in Ganga are made with red bricks.
This gives the city a special style.
When you walk in the streets,
you see old houses, small shops, and narrow roads.
The city looks warm and traditional.
Part six, Khan's garden.
Ganga has a large green park called Khan's garden.
It is one of the oldest parks in Azerbaijan.
You can walk, sit, relax, and enjoy nature.
Families come here to spend time together.
Part seven, the bottle house.
One of the most interesting places in Ganga is the bottle house.
Yes, a house made with thousands of glass bottles.
A man built this house for his brother.
It is very colorful and unique.
Many people love taking photos here.
Part eight, the Ganga Gates.
Ganga has huge and beautiful gates called the Ganga Gates.
These gates are made of iron.
They are very artistic.
They show the rich culture and history of the city.
Part nine, Ganga Lake areas near Ganga.
There are lakes and forests.
One famous lake is Gogol Lake, only a short drive away.
It has clear blue water.
It looks like a painting.
People love to visit and enjoy the fresh air.
Part ten, local food.
Ganga has delicious traditional food.
You can eat doma, peaty soup, and shecky halva.
The food is warm, fresh, and full of flavor.
People in Ganga enjoy drinking tea with sugar and jam.
Part eleven, friendly people.
People in Ganga are very kind.
They welcome guests with a smile.
They like to help visitors.
Talking to them is easy and enjoyable.
They are proud of their history and culture.
Part twelve, closing Ganga is a city of history,
nature, and warm people.
It is one of the most important cities in Azerbaijan.
If you visit Azerbaijan, Ganga is a wonderful place to explore.
